from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and sum(x == row[0] for r in grid for x in r) == w:
            a, b = grid[:i], grid[i + 1:]
            common = set(x for r in a for x in r) & set(x for r in b for x in r)
            color = next(iter(common))
            return [[3 if x == color and y == color else color for x, y in zip(r1, r2)] for r1, r2 in zip(a, b)]
    for j in range(w):
        c = grid[0][j]
        if all(r[j] == c for r in grid) and sum(r[j] == c for r in grid) == h:
            a = [r[:j] for r in grid]
            b = [r[j + 1:] for r in grid]
            common = set(x for r in a for x in r) & set(x for r in b for x in r)
            color = next(iter(common))
            return [[3 if x == color and y == color else color for x, y in zip(r1, r2)] for r1, r2 in zip(a, b)]
    raise ValueError('separator not found')
